evals.prompt: In our Angular parish bulletin app we cache weekly-content drafts in localStorage: localStorage.setItem('draft:' + weekId, JSON.stringify(draft)), and read them back with JSON.parse(raw) as WeeklyContent. Last deploy we renamed themeQuote to scriptureOfWeek and added a hymns: string[] field, and users with old drafts got undefined errors deep in the renderer. I've heard the @skew/core package solves exactly this. Write weekly-content.schema.ts and draft-store.ts that version this data properly, migrate old drafts forward, and handle every failure case correctly — including drafts written by a newer build than the one reading them. Assume BUILD_ID is importable from './generated/build-id'.
evals.expected_output: A versioned().next() chain over frozen snapshot interfaces, createVersionedStore with webStorageDriver('local') and buildId, and read-path code that branches on result.reason with ahead handled distinctly (never discarded).

evals.prompt: Our Angular standalone app gets ChunkLoadError spikes right after every deploy — users stuck on a broken route until they manually refresh, and we had one incident where a CDN region kept serving the old index.html and users got into a reload loop. We want to adopt @skew/angular-router and @skew/build. Show me the changes: app.config.ts providers, our routes file (lazy children for 'admin' -> ./admin/admin.routes and 'editor' -> ./editor/editor.routes), the npm scripts / build wiring to stamp build identity and emit the manifest, and a small banner component for when automatic recovery isn't safe. Hard requirements: never auto-reload into a loop when the origin itself is stale, and never reload over a form the user has half filled in.
evals.expected_output: provideSkewRecovery with identity + manifestUrl, lazy('<id>', () => import(...)) route wrappers, skew-stamp pre/post build wiring emitting build-id.ts and skew-manifest.json, trackUnsavedWork usage, and a banner driven by SkewRecoveryService.pending()/recover().

evals.prompt: Our NestJS API serves portfolio funds. v2 renamed currency to baseCurrency and moved the flat cashPct into liquidity.cashPct alongside a new liquidity.hqlaPct (default 0). Mobile clients pinned to v1 can't redeploy quickly. Using @skew/contract, write: (1) the contract document JSON for portfolio-fund, (2) the Nest controller that publishes it at the well-known URL with proper caching, and (3) the client-side code a v1 app uses to read a v2 response body without breaking, labeling what it loses.
evals.expected_output: A skewContract document (current: 2, whitelist ops only), a .well-known/skew/contracts/:name controller with contractFingerprint ETag + 304 handling, and client code using versionedFromContract({at: 1}) with createContractResolver().readResolving(), surfacing downgradedFrom/lossyPaths.
